create_beitconfig_default: create a BeitConfig instance with default BEiT model configuration parameters
create_beitconfig_custom: create a BeitConfig instance with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and patch_size values
create_beitconfig_backbone: create a BeitConfig instance configured as a backbone with out_indices and out_features for feature extraction
create_beitconfig_segmentation: create a BeitConfig instance with auxiliary head enabled for semantic segmentation training
review_beitconfig: review the BeitConfig class and its default hyperparameters for the BEiT vision transformer model
